story.lead: I build web applications with an emphasis on structure, performance, and clarity. My background combines educational technology and web engineering, focusing on how people interact with software and how to make interfaces reliable and intuitive.
paragraphs: I hold a degree in Educational Technology and work as a front-end engineer. Through an intensive bootcamp at Alterra Academy, I built a foundation across JavaScript, UI design, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs, and modern deployment workflows.

I focus on building accessible, fast, and maintainable front-end systems. Working closely with design systems, I translate design concepts into responsive interfaces that prioritize usability, performance, and clean code.

experience.title: Front-End Engineer
experience.description: Building high-performance web applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Focused on Lighthouse scores above 90%, responsive design, and production-ready interfaces.
